subject: Cerebral Health: on-prem segmentation, standby clusters and term uplift
messages:
From: Elena Vázquez <elena.vazquez@cerebralhealth.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@cerebralhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — isolation & standby capacity needs

Hi Kimberly,

As we approach our renewal window (Oct 1), I wanted to start the conversation about the private footprint expansion we discussed at the kickoff. Our security team has asked for a formal plan to:

- Add two additional isolated clusters in our EU region (separate tenant)
- Reserve a standby cluster for failover during peak analytics runs
- Extend the term from 12 to 24 months in exchange for committed capacity pricing

I've attached a short demand forecast so you can see the expected token volumes and burst patterns. Procurement will need the proposed SLA language and a clear timeline for provisioning — ideally with a month-by-month gating plan.

Can you confirm vendor timelines and a rough price delta for the standby cluster + 24-month term?

Thanks — happy to jump on a call this week.

Best,
Elena Vázquez
Director, Cloud Platforms
Cerebral Health Systems
Attachment: Cerebral_Demand_Forecast_Q3Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet, 132KB)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vázquez <elena.vazquez@cerebralhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@cerebralhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — isolation & standby capacity needs

Elena — thanks for the forecast and the clear ask. High-level response below; I'll follow up with a draft SLA and an itemized uplift estimate by EOD Thursday.

What we can do now:
- Provisioning timeline: 6–8 weeks for two isolated EU clusters (private control plane, customer-managed VPC setup).
- Standby cluster: can be reserved as a cold standby that we can warm in ~48 hours; warm standby is available for an incremental monthly fee.
- Pricing: with a 24-month commit we can offer a 12% discount on the standby cluster and lock current rates for the isolated clusters.

Open items I need from your team:
1) Target geographic subregion in EU (we typically use frankfurt or netherlands for data residency)
2) Any additional compliance evidence required beyond SOC2 (ISO27001, DPA addendum, or localization attestation)
3) Expected RPO (how many hours of data we must guarantee replication for the standby)

I'll attach the SLA draft and a redline-ready term sheet in my next mail. Ben — looping you for the capacity/ops details (scheduling + queuing during provisioning).

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — reliable inference at scale

Attachment: (will follow)

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — isolation & standby capacity needs

Kim — quick ops note you can pass to Elena:

- 6–8 week provisioning assumes we can run onboarding in parallel: network peering, KMS integration, and a short security scan. If customer wants a private control plane in their VPC we need their network diagram and an SRE contact by Week 1.
- For cold standby we recommend a snapshot cadence of 4 hours for analytics workloads; warm standby requires continuous replication and adds roughly 18–22% to monthly infrastructure cost (depends on model sizes).
- If they want automated failover, we need to add a canary and a brief DR playbook which is typically a 2-week project we bill as professional services.

I'll draft a short ops summary to include in the SLA appendix.

—Ben
Staff Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vázquez <elena.vazquez@cerebralhealth.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: itops <itops@cerebralhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — isolation & standby capacity needs

Elena — two quick technical clarifications from our side so we size properly:

1) Model mix: are you planning inference-only workloads on the isolated clusters, or will training / fine-tuning happen there as well? Training requires different cluster sizing and can change the node type.
2) Prefix cache expectation: do you expect cross-tenant shared caches for inference bursts? For strict isolation we recommend per-tenant caches which increases memory footprint but avoids noisy neighbor issues.

If you can confirm those two, I can map to node types and give an explicit CPU/GPU breakdown. Also looping your itops here — it would help if you could share the network CIDR blocks and KMS key alias for testing.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SLA_AMENDMENT_draft.pdf (pdf, 58KB)

From: IT Ops <itops@cerebralhealth.com>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — isolation & standby capacity needs

Hi Monica / Kim —

Thanks for the questions. Quick answers from our infra team:
- Workloads: inference only for the isolated clusters; training will remain in our centralized research environment.
- Caching: we prefer strict per-tenant caches due to PHI risk.
- Region: prefer Frankfurt (eu-central-1) for latency and compliance.
- KMS alias: alias/chs-prod-redwood (we will share a temporary test key for onboarding).

We can provide the network CIDR and an SRE contact by Aug 17.

Regards,
Carlos M. (on behalf of IT Ops)
Cerebral Health Systems

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vázquez <elena.vazquez@cerebralhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@cerebralhealth.com>, IT Ops <itops@cerebralhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — isolation & standby capacity needs

Thanks, everyone — summary and next steps below. I've also uploaded the SLA draft and the itemized pricing to the drive link.

Summary of agreed approach:
- Provision two isolated EU clusters in frankfurt, inference-only, per-tenant caches. Provisioning ETA: 6 weeks after SRE kickoff (we should aim to start onboarding the week of Sept 6).
- Standby cluster: cold standby with 4-hour snapshot cadence. Option to upgrade to warm standby for +18% infra cost.
- Term: 24 months with a 12% committed-cap discount on the isolated clusters; standby pricing negotiable once they pick warm vs cold.
- Compliance: we'll include SOC2 + DPA addendum in the SLA appendix; Redwood to provide ISO/attestation matrix within 5 business days.

Action items:
1) Elena / Procurement: confirm go/no-go on 24-month term and preferred standby mode by Aug 20.
2) CHS IT Ops: share CIDR + SRE contact by Aug 17.
3) Redwood (Ben/Monica): finalize ops appendix and DR playbook estimate by Aug 24.
4) Redwood (Kim): prepare redline-ready SLA and DocuSign packet by Aug 27.

If you prefer, I can set a 30-minute alignment call next week (available Tue/Thu morning).

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
